about: gary is an ordinary guy who keeps ending up inside our games. this is his log. newest first.

entries.title: the pond
entries.text: went fishing for 60 seconds. caught a boot, a phone and what i can only describe as a feeling. the pond kept the rod.

entries.title: the pop-up
entries.text: tried to close one pop-up. there were thirty. the x ran away every time. so did my lunch break.

entries.title: tic tac no
entries.text: beat the computer at tic tac toe. it blue-screened, spilled coffee on the board and called it a draw. i am appealing.

entries.title: +1 speed
entries.text: every key i pressed made me faster. i pressed all of them. i am writing this from a different postcode.

entries.title: level 4
entries.text: the floor disappeared. i did not. well, briefly. the exit moved twice and the cursor laughed at me.

entries.title: 47 tabs
entries.text: opened one tab for a recipe. the computer is now 102 degrees and the recipe is still loading.

entries.title: garden incident
entries.text: a granny on a mobility scooter bowled a gnome at me. i was not involved. then i was very involved.

entries.title: overdue
entries.text: my library book is fourteen years late. the fine has its own pop-up now, and a piggy bank, and a lawyer.
